data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 饮品单
data.description: 菜单上有两种没见过的饮品，她犹豫了一会儿，决定先问问店员哪一种更清爽。
data.promptProse: At a sunny sidewalk cafe terrace, Angelina peruses an illustrated drinks menu while sitting beside a sweating glass of iced citrus tea. The cafe's striped awning flutters in the breeze as dappled sunlight dances across the wooden tabletop.
data.animaCaption: Tapping the illustrated menu with her finger, she ponders between seasonal sodas, enjoying the afternoon terrace breeze.
